_comment: ISO3 codes AfTS-Db actually covers that count as Africa. Derived from from_iso3/to_iso3 in africa_roads_network.gpkg (61 unique codes), minus 4 non-Africa codes (ESP Spain, ISR Israel -- bbox overflow from the original OSM 'africa-latest' extract; Planet does have data for these two, excluded anyway; ESH Western Sahara, PSE Palestine, SHN Saint Helena, NAM Namibia -- Planet has no dataset for these, so they're not in this list either way). Checked 2026-09-18: standard 54 African states + Mayotte (MYT) + Reunion (REU), matches the earlier '55/58 geographic entities' figure.
